verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability ships AI features (a natural-language telemetry assistant and the nightshift AI SRE), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or any way to register third-party tool servers for its AI to call. Integrations, OpenTelemetry ingestion and alert notification connectors are data or notification paths, not MCP client support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
